meta.title: Columbia County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Columbia County's 2026 final budget, adopted by Ordinance 2025-28 on November 10, 2025, as filed with the state. We use the "Budget 2026" column. Some funds move money to other county funds (transfer lines, $774,910.00 in all), so those dollars appear in both funds.
